removedWrongBinding.objectiveJa: 果樹の地域説明と調整剤の目的、まき方と暗きょの構造を、出典の範囲を保って説明できる。
removedWrongBinding.reuseReasonJa: 「1号の果樹・作業用語を出典の範囲で読む」で扱う対象を、既存の「人工授粉器の二例とぼんてん」の図上位置・外観と対応させて確認します。図にない性質や数値まで読み取らないでください。
removedWrongBinding.scopeReasonJa: 既存図の対象・位置の観察を本課の基礎事項に限定して使い、図中の出典別条件を他の級の操作指示へ広げません。

actualDefect: Pollination tools do not represent this lesson regional-fruit/growth-purpose/sowing/drainage objective. Correct pollination primary retained.
replacement: Source-term native comparison supports the four sowing/drainage paragraphs: seeds across a bed, in one row, in separated plural-seed groups; pipe below soil surface. Broader regional-fruit prose remains in main lesson; diagram does not claim to illustrate all paragraphs.
diagramScope: Qualitative original native geometry; depicted dot numbers, distances and pipe position are not seed-rate/spacing/depth specifications. No copied source pixels, installation procedure or inferred operating dimensions.
